claims.text: Salicylates: urine alkalinization to urine pH 7.5–8.5 after volume and electrolytes are corrected; indicated with any sx of poisoning, don't wait for levels
claims.quote: After volume and electrolyte abnormalities are corrected, urine alkalinization can be used to increase and maintain urine pH between 7.5 and 8.5 (2). Urine alkalinization is indicated for patients with any symptoms of poisoning and should not be delayed until salicylate levels are determined.

claims.text: Give extra potassium chloride: hypokalemia interferes with urine alkalinization
claims.quote: Because hypokalemia may interfere with urine alkalinization, patients are given a solution consisting of 1 L of 5% D/W, 3 50-mEq (50-mmol) ampules of sodium bicarbonate, and 40 mEq (40 mmol) of potassium chloride
